segments.text: Surya Vigyan, Subtle Bodies, and the Concept of Interdependency
Introduction: The Three Subtle Bodies (Sukshma Sharir ) (0:00 - 6:30)
Today, we are discussing a deeper concept within Surya Vigyan (Sun Science). To understand this, we must revisit the concept of the subtle body (Sukshma Sharir ).
There are three main durations for these subtle bodies within us:
1. 4 hours to 4 days 2. 4 days to 4 months 3. 4 months to 40 years

When a soul is born — let's say for its 1001st lifetime — it carries the subtle bodies of its past 1000 lives. These past subtle bodies constantly cycle into your current physical body, usually changing every few hours or days. This is why your mood, desires, and energy levels fluctuate day by day. Over time, the repetitive actions and desires from your past lives form a dominant pattern, which connects to your "great subtle body" (Maha Sukshma Sharir ).
"Kicking" a Subtle Body and Awakening Past Life Siddhis (6:30 - 11:30)
There is a concept in Surya Vigyan called "kicking" or rejecting a subtle body.

For example, imagine a subtle body cycles in that gives you an intense urge to play football for the next 4 months. The universe will automatically align situations, friends, and circumstances to make you play football. However, if you actively resist this urge — if you "kick" this subtle body away and decide to do spiritual practice (Sadhana ) instead — a massive shift happens.

By rejecting that current physical urge, you increase the energy of the spiritual path you chose. This heightened energy reaches back into your past lives and attracts the Siddhis (spiritual powers or attainments) of every past lifetime where you performed spiritual practice. By constantly "kicking" worldly subtle bodies to focus on your path, you pull your past -life powers into your current reality.
Relationships and the Concept of Interdependency (11:30 - 28:00)

Now, let's look at this from a relationship perspective. When you meet someone, it is because your subtle bodies have aligned for a specific period — say, 4 months. During that time, you naturally share a bond. But what happens when that 4 -month period ends, the subtle body shifts, but you consciously refuse to let the person go?

When you hold onto a relationship past its natural subtle -body expiration (effectively "kicking" the new incoming subtle body to keep the old bond), a magical phenomenon occurs: The Concept of Interdependency .

Your Siddhis (spiritual powers/energies) begin transferring to them, and theirs begin transferring to you. If this bond is maintained over decades (like a 20 -year friendship or a lifelong marriage), your energies become completely entwined.

Because of this interdependency, if a highly spiritually charged person sits miles away and simply says, "Don't worry, your work will be done," it happens. The power behind their words utilizes your combined energies. This is exactly why ancient saints and Gurus advised keeping your social circle incredibly small. Every time you form deep, lingering bonds, you distribute and scatter your spiritual power. Devoting yourself to a single path or a true Gu ru consolidates that immense power instead of draining it.
The Physics of Spirituality: String Theory and Frames of Reference (28:00 - 41:15)

Surya Vigyan operates exactly like multi -dimensional quantum physics. Imagine an X and Y graph. Place "Past Life Siddhis" on the X -axis and "Relationship Interdependency" on the Y - axis. Because these concepts are universally connected (similar to Quantum Coherence or S tring Theory), whatever damages your relationships on the Y -axis will automatically damage your spiritual powers on the X -axis, and vice versa. They are completely interdependent.

This also applies to how we perceive reality. In physics, we talk about a "Frame of Reference." If two people stand in different places looking at the same object, they see entirely different angles. Divine vision (Drishti ) teaches you to stop looking at life from a fixed point. You must learn to change your plane of reference to see the truth of the subtle world.
In the next session, we will explore a new dimension: What happens energetically when one person in a relationship lets go, but the other person refuses to?
